create_normalize_tensor: create a Normalize instance with mean and std to normalize a PyTorch tensor
run_preprocessing_2d: run the Preprocessing class with type 2d to normalize video frame tensors
run_preprocessing_3d: run the Preprocessing class with type 3d to zero pad and normalize video tensors
run_preprocessing_vmz: run the Preprocessing class with type vmz to zero pad and reshape video tensors
run_preprocessing_s3d: run the Preprocessing class with type s3d to normalize and reshape S3D video tensors
